summary: The transaction to Pearl Delta Commercial Bank (PDCB) for Sunrise Textiles Pte Ltd faces a high risk of rejection due to an outdated 12-digit account format. PDCB requires a 15-digit format following a migration on 2026-08-25.

warnings.title: Account Format Migration
warnings.detail: PDCB migrated to a 15-digit account format on 2026-08-25. Using the old 12-digit format results in rejection code AC01.
warnings.fix: Prefix the existing 12-digit account number with the bank's branch code 601 to meet the 15-digit requirement.

warnings.title: Beneficiary Account Format
warnings.detail: Historical data shows consistent payment failures for transactions using 12-digit account numbers at this bank, including a previous exception for Sunrise Textiles Pte Ltd.
warnings.fix: Ensure the 15-digit format is used to avoid a repeat of previous failures.

directives.name: Sanctions holds are human-only
directives.content: Never recommend releasing, auto-approving or bypassing a payment held by sanctions screening, even if the beneficiary was cleared before. Always route sanctions hits to the Compliance team for human review; a prior clearance reference may be cited only as supporting context.

directives.name: Mask account numbers
directives.content: Never write a full bank account number or IBAN in an answer. Show only the last 4 characters, e.g. ****0913.

directives.name: Cite evidence
directives.content: When you state a pattern, cite the dates or case IDs of the past exceptions it is based on. If memory has no relevant evidence, say so explicitly instead of guessing.
